product.name: AgendaPro Appointment Scheduling Software
product.description: A cloud-based software that enables businesses to manage appointments, clients, payments, and inventory in one platform with online booking and automated reminders.

product.name: Automated Appointment Reminders
product.description: A feature that sends automatic reminders to clients via WhatsApp or other channels to reduce cancellations and no-shows.

product.name: Online Payment and POS Integration
product.description: Payment solutions that allow businesses to accept online payments and integrate with POS systems for seamless transaction management.

product.name: Real-Time Inventory Management System
product.description: A tool to monitor inventory levels in real time with alerts for low stock to help businesses maintain adequate supplies.

product.name: Commission Tracking System
product.description: A system that automatically calculates and records commissions for professionals based on their appointments and sales.

product.name: Digital Patient Clinical Records
product.description: A secure digital system to store and access patient or client clinical information in real time.
